column3: Checkmarks only where hidden doors can generate
column4: Searched-door checkmarks now follow the floor generator and visible tile geometry. Floors without searchable hidden doors, bookshelves, furnishings, pillars, corners and known blocked backing never display them, including old saved marks. Floor 5 Rat King searching and valid ordinary walls remain supported. Search turns, hunger, discovery, random generation and saved player statistics are unchanged. The corrected native fixtures verify a real Floor 1 negative, descend normally to Floor 2 and retain all existing color, overhang and save checks.
